notes.title: Magnet Block v1.32
notes.content:
Updated jams to have positionally dependent logic instead of being id based.

This fixes some fringe issues when two gravity ticked blocks of the same polarity acted on a third stationary block, producing different results depending on what blocks were used in which position.
No puzzle relies or should even be solvable with ambiguous directional/update dependent logic so no logic paths have changed.


The level count now scales up with what is currently unlocked instead of displaying the total level count.
